rule: Financial features use only values dated <= t. Calendar features are pure functions of the date; those describing [t+1, t+30] contain wall-calendar arithmetic only and no realised financial value.
note_target_scale: scale = 30 * trailing 30-day mean inflow is the target normaliser, not a model feature. It is trailing-only.

features.name: in_seasonal_dev
features.description: in_mean30[t] / in_mean180[t] - current inflow level against its own six-month baseline; the seasonal position indicator

features.name: doy_cos2
features.description: cos(4*pi*day_of_year/365.25) - second annual harmonic

features.name: doy_sin1
features.description: sin(2*pi*day_of_year/365.25) - first annual harmonic

features.name: fwd30_is_payday
features.description: fraction of the next 30 calendar days falling on the 27th (salary date)

features.name: yoy_growth
features.description: in_mean30[t] / in_mean30[t-365] - year-over-year growth of the trailing inflow level

features.name: burn_ratio90
features.description: out_mean90[t] / in_mean90[t] - share of inflow consumed by outflow over 90 days

features.name: days_of_coverage
features.description: closing_balance[t] / out_mean30[t] - days of cash runway at the recent burn rate

features.name: fwd30_is_tax
features.description: fraction of the next 30 days falling on a quarterly VAT/zakat settlement date (15 Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct)

features.name: balance_to_in30
features.description: closing_balance[t] / in_mean30[t] - cash buffer expressed in days of recent inflow

features.name: yoy_target
features.description: realised net cash flow over the 30-day window one year ago; net_sum30_past shifted 335 days

features.name: net_mean180
features.description: trailing 180-day mean of net_cash_flow - the structural cash-generation level

features.name: fwd30_in_ramadan
features.description: fraction of the next 30 days falling inside Ramadan

features.name: opening_balance
features.description: cash at the start of day t (equals closing_balance[t-1])

features.name: doy_sin2
features.description: sin(4*pi*day_of_year/365.25) - second annual harmonic

features.name: fwd30_doy_c2
features.description: mean of the second cosine harmonic across the next 30 days - seasonal position of the forecast window

features.name: yoy_target_scaled
features.description: yoy_target * yoy_growth - last year's realised window rescaled to this year's business size

features.name: closing_balance
features.description: cash at the end of day t

features.name: net_std90
features.description: trailing 90-day standard deviation of net_cash_flow - medium-term volatility

features.name: net_mean90
features.description: trailing 90-day mean of net_cash_flow

features.name: fwd30_doy_s1
features.description: mean of the first sine harmonic across the next 30 days

features.name: fwd30_is_wknd
features.description: fraction of the next 30 days that are Friday or Saturday (Saudi weekend)

features.name: net_std30
features.description: trailing 30-day standard deviation of net_cash_flow - short-term volatility

features.name: momentum_in
features.description: in_mean30[t] / in_mean90[t] - short-term inflow momentum

features.name: doy_cos1
features.description: cos(2*pi*day_of_year/365.25) - first annual harmonic

features.name: yoy_in_mean
features.description: trailing 30-day mean inflow as it stood one year ago

features.name: momentum_out
features.description: out_mean30[t] / out_mean90[t] - short-term expense momentum

features.name: net_lag30
features.description: net_cash_flow exactly 30 days before t

features.name: days_from_eid_fitr
features.description: signed days to the nearest Eid al-Fitr, clipped to +/-120

features.name: fwd30_doy_c1
features.description: mean of the first cosine harmonic across the next 30 days

features.name: days_to_month_end
features.description: days_in_month - day_of_month; governs how many monthly events fall inside the forecast window
